meta.title: Kafka Express — learn Apache Kafka by playing
meta.description: A visual game that teaches Apache Kafka: route parcels, run partitions and keep the city's events flowing.

landing.title: Kafka Express
landing.tagline: You're the new dispatcher. Route every event in the city — no losses, no duplicates, no jams.

play.title: Dispatch desk
play.subtitle: Topic “orders” · 3 partitions
play.hint: Send an order. Watch which belt it lands on — then send the same customer again.
play.insight: Same key → same partition → same order. Always.
